Root `pom.xml` is a Maven parent (`pom`) aggregating `ecommerce-common` and services: `user-service`, `product-service`, `inventory-service`, `cart-service`, `order-service`, `payment-service`, `shipping-service`. Standard layout: `<module>/src/main/java`, `<module>/src/main/resources` (`application.yml`), `<module>/src/test/java`. Root deployment assets: `Dockerfile`, `docker-compose.yml`. Prereqs: Java 21, Maven 3.9+, Docker.

Commands:
`mvn clean package`
`mvn -pl user-service -am package`
`mvn -pl user-service spring-boot:run`
`java -jar user-service/target/user-service-0.0.1-SNAPSHOT.jar`
`docker compose up --build`
`mvn test`
`mvn -pl order-service test`

Use 4-space indentation, one public class/file, packages `com.example.ecommerce.<service>` with `controller`, `entity`, `repository`, `service`. Controllers include `UserController`, mapped `/api/...`; entities include `User`, `OrderItem`; repositories include Spring Data JPA `UserRepository`. Use `lowerCamelCase`, constants `UPPER_SNAKE_CASE`. Prefer existing Lombok and shared `ecommerce-common` types such as `ApiResponse`. Add JUnit 5/Spring Boot tests under `<module>/src/test/java`; names: `*Test`, `*IT`.

Use Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `refactor:`, `docs:`), with module scope, e.g. `feat(user-service): add address endpoints`. PRs include summary, affected modules, API examples, schema/config notes; ensure module tests pass before merging. Service config: `src/main/resources/application.yml`. Do not commit secrets; prefer environment variables. DB defaults are in `docker-compose.yml`: `jdbc:mysql://mysql:3306/ecommerce`, user/password `ecommerce`.
